notes:
A350 and 777:
• Fixed: Order and Add to bag no longer undo themselves, on the first order of a zone and after the crew served one.
• New: one dish per course. A dessert or a wine no longer replaces your main, and Business can order a second main.
• New: Your orders in the top bar, on every page: each dish and item with its state, to cancel or remove.
• New: crew messages on any page when your meal is being prepared, served, or your shopping is brought.
• Improved: Duty free has Remove from bag, In your bag on the photo, and the bag's state.
• Improved: the Dining and Duty free tiles on Home show what you ordered and what is in your bag.
• Improved: cancelling asks first, and the order strip lists every dish.
• Fixed: Below you, Journey, weather and quiz labels no longer overlap or show wrong text.
• Improved: much lighter on the sim. Flight full screen turns all pictures together, a switched-off zone draws nothing, zones repaint at different moments.
A350:
• Improved: orders on the FAP are grouped by seat, with the right seat, the waiting time, and the oldest first.
• Fixed: a meal served from the FAP no longer comes back as waiting; orders of past flights are gone.
• Fixed: the cabin light no longer jumps at 10,000 ft, and step climbs or descents no longer wake a sleeping cabin.
• Fixed: no more flashes in fast light changes; strips go out and come back with the power.
• Improved: GSX passengers are only read while the page is open, and shade arrows take quick double taps.
777:
• Fixed: the light no longer jumps at 10,000 ft (measured above the ground), and the curtains are not redrawn every second.
• Fixed: sunrise light no longer lasts into the landing; with no power the lights go out at once.
• Fixed: lights set by the pilot go back to the scenes after IFE off, a new plan or the arrival.
App:
• Improved: films, YouTube and the phone map answer faster and use less CPU; a paused film uses almost none.
• Fixed: long flights no longer pile up Windows resources, and many screens at once no longer hang.
• Fixed: A350 and 777 in different Community folders are both found; Update now waits for a running install.
• Improved: the app opens faster and an install needs less memory.
